# Miux Studio

> Miux Studio is a selective creative studio and engineering lab crafting high-converting websites, digital brands, and custom platforms for startups and digital businesses across Asia and the UAE.

## Core Services
- **Brand Design & Identity**: Complete visual systems, brand strategy, design systems, and identity assets.
- **Web Design & UI/UX**: Conversion-engineered interfaces, interactive prototyping, and modern dark-mode aesthetic design.
- **Web Development**: Ultra-fast Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and fluid Framer Motion animations.
- **Campaigns & Growth Platforms**: High-converting landing pages, marketing funnels, and enterprise SaaS websites.

## Pricing & Engagement Models
- **Free**: Open-source starter templates, blocks, and custom animations.
- **Pro ($99)**: Lifetime access to custom templates, blocks, illustrations, and animations with free updates.
- **Pro Team ($499)**: Complete access for agencies and engineering teams to all templates, design systems, and section libraries.
- **Custom Client Partnerships**: Dedicated design & development sprints starting with a discovery consultation.
